_comment: Two tenants, for the isolation tests and for quickstart.md scenario 7.
The keys these hash are 'acme-test-key-not-a-secret' and
'globex-test-key-not-a-secret', and they are written down in
tests/support.py rather than here — this file holds SHA-256 hashes and
never keys, which is the whole point of the format: a leak of a real one
is not a set of working credentials.
